description: SERIAL combined with a table-level PRIMARY KEY (id) constraint (rather than a column-level one) is still recognized, since sqlite3's AUTOINCREMENT can only be expressed as a column-level constraint -- Rewrite must move the PRIMARY KEY down to the column itself for this to be legal sqlite3 at all

body: CREATE TABLE tE{{DLID}} (id SERIAL, name TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (id))

tests.name: id auto-generated as 1 via promoted column-level PK
